item.question: How does the Time Aware Shaper (TAS) ensure timely message delivery in networks?
item.answer: The Time Aware Shaper (TAS) ensures timely message delivery by controlling queue gates through a Gate Control List (GCL), which schedules traffic to meet specific timing requirements.
